name: Yunlin
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: -3 to -7 cm/yr across inland townships (Huwei, Tuku, Yuanchang), peaking > -7 cm/yr during dry pumping seasons (Hung et al., 2010)
literature_sources: Hung, W.C. et al. (2010), Journal of Hydrology, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jhydrol.2010.03.005
agreement_note: Consistent in magnitude (-2.7 cm LOS, -3.4 cm vertical est., -2.5 cm/100d over 108 days), though 28.2% valid pixels over humid subtropical rice farmland and reference spread [-3.5, -1.1] cm limit confidence to low.
press_summary_gate_note: Kept indicative_only due to 28.2% valid pixels and reference spread [-3.5, -1.1] cm (ratio 0.89).
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
